mapper.insert: insert into attractions (poi_id, parent_poi_id, name, address, location, pcode, pname, citycode, cityname, adcode, adname, type, typecode, distance) values (#{poiId}, #{parentPoiId}, #{name}, #{address}, #{location}, #{pcode}, #{pname}, #{citycode}, #{cityname}, #{adcode}, #{adname}, #{type}, #{typecode}, #{distance})
mapper.update: update attractions set parent_poi_id = #{parentPoiId}, name = #{name}, address = #{address}, location = #{location}, pcode = #{pcode}, pname = #{pname}, citycode = #{citycode}, cityname = #{cityname}, adcode = #{adcode}, adname = #{adname}, type = #{type}, typecode = #{typecode}, distance = #{distance} where poi_id = #{poiId}
mapper.select: select poi_id, parent_poi_id, name, address, location, pcode, pname, citycode, cityname, adcode, adname, type, typecode, distance, created_at, updated_at from attractions

select poi_id, parent_poi_id, name, address, location, pcode, pname, citycode, cityname, adcode, adname, type, typecode, distance, created_at, updated_at from attractions
and (adcode = #{regionCode} or left(adcode, 4) = left(#{regionCode}, 4))
order by updated_at desc, created_at desc
